name: 92. Custom provider does_not_send_done_marker keeps trailing usage with wait_for_usage (#7143) (done-marker-usage)
description:
Issue #7143: custom_provider_config.does_not_send_done_marker ended the OpenAI-compatible
read loop the instant a non-empty finish_reason arrived. OpenAI sends the usage-only frame
AFTER that frame and before [DONE] (see folder 91), so the loop never read it and the
synthesized terminal chunk carried a zero-valued usage object - logging, pricing,
virtual-key usage, budgets and cost attribution all recorded the request at zero tokens
and zero cost.

No fixture upstream is needed: the flag is a declaration about the upstream, not a
description of it, so pointing a custom provider carrying the flag at real OpenAI
reproduces the loss exactly. openai_dnsdm and openai_dnsdm_wait are registered in
tests/integrations/python/config.json for these three items.

92.1 is the regression guard. 92.2 pins the documented default so it cannot change
silently for operators who did not opt in. 92.3 is the unconfigured control that makes
92.2 read as a deliberate difference rather than a broken fixture.
